fonts.display: 'PublicaSans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'PublicaSans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Amp Orange
palette.role: Primary action fill, active step badge, accent rule, and brand strokes — the only chromatic color in the interface. Used at high contrast on white surfaces (7.0:1 against #ffffff) and as a warm border tint on cards and inputs

palette.name: Amp Glow
palette.role: Orange supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Peach Wash
palette.role: Soft highlight surface for featured cards and step accents. A near-gray peach that stays quiet while adding warmth to a card stack

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary text, logo mark, button text. 19.8:1 against white — the highest-contrast neutral in the stack

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Secondary text and nav links, slightly softer than Ink. Icon strokes also draw from this level

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated.

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Disabled link text and placeholder-level text — the quietest text tone before disappearing

palette.name: Graphite Hairline
palette.role: The dominant border color across the site — dividers, card borders, button outlines, and structural rules. By far the most-used neutral (1628+ borderColor occurrences)

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Soft border for cards and body blocks where #e5e5e5 reads as too crisp against off-white

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Neutral button fill (88 occurrences) — the ghost/secondary button background. A light step above canvas

palette.name: Canvas White
palette.role: Page background, card surfaces, button text on dark and orange fills. The base of the surface stack

palette.name: Linen
palette.role: Off-white alt surface — secondary button fills and surface tints where pure white is too clinical

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Dark elevated surface for cards, headers, and contained panels.

palette.name: Smoke
palette.role: Heading underline accent in dark sections, heavier than Carbon
